ownerGuidance: Do not ask users for passwords, MFA codes, recovery codes, tokens, private keys, or payment details.
Route submissions through host-owned Forms storage and support workflows.

docsArticles.displayName: Sign in and create your account

runtimeBehavior.install: Starter metadata becomes available as Forms and Docs starter cards without creating owner-owned docs rows.
runtimeBehavior.authFlowPlacement: Login, create-account, forgot-password, reset-password, email verification, instant-link verification, and invite acceptance starters are content templates with cedros-login:auth-form, not generic Forms templates.
runtimeBehavior.startDraft: Docs article starter cards become actual owner-owned draft docs rows only after an owner chooses Start Draft.
runtimeBehavior.disable: Starters are hidden for new creation; existing owner-created content is preserved.
runtimeBehavior.remove: Starter metadata is removed; existing owner-created forms/docs remain unless the owner deletes them.
